XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Engine warning light coming on and noticeable drop in performance
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | P0236 | P0238 | SOLENOID VALVE | PRESSURE | SUPERCHARGING | PRESSURE | AIR | TURBO | ENGINE | RUNNING | MIL | YELLOW | CAUSES | LOSES | DROPS | LACK | POWER | SPEED | DROP |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Boost pressure solenoid valve

  • Fault: Engine fault light illuminated with reduced performance

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis:
  • P0236 (Boost pressure sensor 1 – Incorrect setpoint)
  • P0238 (Boost Pressure Sensor 1 - High Value)
  • Cause: Faulty boost pressure solenoid valve

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the boost pressure solenoid valve; replace it if necessary.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The component in question is located centrally between the engine and the radiator on the upper part of the engine.

    The estimated time for the procedure is approximately 0.4 hours.
